newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan Corpoven lifts Monagas crude reserves.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan Corpoven lifts Monagas crude reserves.

text.p: PDVSA subsidiary Corpoven said it increased its crude oil reserves in the eastern Venezuelan state of Monagas by 478 million barrels in 1996 to 3.928 billion barrels.

Corpoven said it achieved all its targets in 1996 as production in Monagas reached 413,000 barrels per day (bpd), against a previous 397,000 bpd. This implied an additional 16.6 million barrels produced in the year and an unforeseen revenue of $256 million.
Monagas state has the best exploration prospects in the whole eastern half of the country, according to the statement.
